description:
Procedurally generate a playable, multiplayer 3D world -- zones, quests, NPCs, creatures, their bodies, rigs, clips and style renders -- from Saga narrative and Prometheus balance, into a World of ClaudeCraft-derived realm and the CoC story engine at once, with the same character carried into awdesk and a Space.

Includes: awavatar, awdk, awsprite, awrtifact, awrun
